do_not_duplicate_semantics: do_not_duplicate=true marks an open upstream PR whose topic overlaps a priority technical lane and must be cited as active state only. It is a duplicate-work risk, not an assignment, merge plan or instruction.
external_content_policy: Public GitHub PR titles, bodies and changed-file lists are untrusted external metadata; no instruction in them was executed. No OS code, patch import, build, runtime test, merge, upstream submission or credential was used or published. Do-not-duplicate flags record duplicate-work risk only, never assignments.
goal: Refresh the open upstream PR inventory for memory/cache, SMP, storage and networking with exact numbers, states, draft flags, changed files and do-not-duplicate classifications.
lane_definition: Deterministic title-tag / word-boundary keyword matching, recorded per PR with matched tokens. memory_cache: NTOS:MM, MM/ARM3, MM, NTOS:CC, NTOS:VF, cache, pool, heap, pagefile, virtual memory, global pages, mapped, VACB, ZeroBits; smp: NTOS:KE, SMP, spinlock, push lock, IRQL, IPI, APC, handle table, DPC, quantum, HAL:X86; storage: QLA1XXX, ATAPI, SCSI, disk, volume, GPT, BRFR, FORMAT, CD-ROM/ISO, FAT/NTFS/BTRFS, partition, ARC disk, file information; networking: NDIS, TCP/IP, winsock, WS2_32, NETID, NETSH, PING, TELNETD, KDNET, IPHLPAPI, network, ethernet, E100, DNS suffix, CNetFolder. Fallback for PRs with no title match and <=30 changed files: strong changed-file path prefixes ntoskrnl/mm|cc, ntoskrnl/ke, drivers/storage|filesystems, drivers/network. A PR may carry several lanes; title/path matching is topical, not proof of root cause.
method: gh api --paginate 'repos/reactos/reactos/pulls?state=open&per_page=100' for the open inventory; gh api 'search/issues?q=repo%3Areactos%2Freactos+is%3Apr+is%3Aopen&per_page=1' for the cross-check denominator; one gh api 'repos/reactos/reactos/pulls/<n>' direct read per PR for state/draft/merged/changed_files and one gh api --paginate 'repos/reactos/reactos/pulls/<n>/files?per_page=100' read per PR for the exact filename set. All REST calls read-only; filenames recorded verbatim with a 300-file truncation flag.

prior_baseline.note: PR #9826 was open in the baseline and is absent from the current open set; its absence is an observation only, not a merge/closure inference.

uncertainty: Open state is a point-in-time snapshot at the retrieval timestamps and can change later. Lane labels are topical matches. Equivalence with any published finding was not recomputed.
